gaps.sentence: I've always wanted ___ how to sail.
He apologized for ___ so abrupt in the meeting.

gaps.explanation: pretend + to-infinitive; negative: not to hear.

gaps.sentence: They managed ___ the fire before it spread.
gaps.explanation: manage takes the to-infinitive: managed to put out.

gaps.sentence: Do you want me ___ you at the station?
gaps.explanation: want + object + to-infinitive: want me to meet.

gaps.sentence: I look forward to ___ your suggestions at the meeting.

gaps.explanation: avoid is followed by -ing: avoid talking.

gaps.sentence: She made her son ___ his room before dinner.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive: made him tidy (passive takes to: was made to tidy).
